correctness.rationale: Schwarz lemma reduces universal UCV of dilates to φ(D_r) lying inside the convex parabola Re q>|q−1|, and explicit canonical f0 establishes converse. For w=s e^{iθ}, x=cosθ, the package computes the quartic defect F(s,x)=s⁴x⁴−s⁴x²+2s³x³−2s³x+3s²x²−2s²+2sx+1. Since Re φ(w)>0 for |w|<1 (seen independently from its boundary quadratic), F>0 is equivalent to the parabolic inclusion on this image. F(s,±1)=(1±s)²; any first interior zero solves F=F_x=0. Independent exact Sympy elimination reconstructed Res_x(F,F_x/(2s))=−s^16Q(s) with Q=s^6−4s^4+23s²−9, Q strictly increasing on (0,1), and rho=0.646983632244827. Independent numerical substitution in the exact subresultant cosine x=−0.4910049966330048 gives F=F_x=0. Positivity for all s<rho, convexity of the parabola, and f0′=exp(z+z²/4) prove sharpness. The packaged checker was read but not blindly treated as an authority.
residual_risks: Full φ(D_s) containment uses positive real part of φ and the convex UCV target; the package abbreviated this elementary positivity step.
The theorem is for t=1/2 only.
